label: Late in episode, higher after seeing S1 / believing S1 good, lower after S2.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase != GO) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/10)
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo * np.exp(ep_trial/10) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial/10)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 20 sits near +1 most of the episode and drops sharply in the last ~20 trials (timing). Its deviations beyond timing grow roughly exponentially with episode trial, so every term is scaled by exp(ep_trial/10) (unscaled versions reach only 0.25 dev in the free fit vs 0.58 scaled). At D1 it is higher when the previous trial reached S1 and lower when it reached S2; at D1 and D2 it rises with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good. GO is nearly unaffected. The free fit adds: at D1 a lower value after rewarded trials and after a1 choices; at D2 higher after choosing a1 and lower specifically on a2->S1 rare transitions. No future or model-output variables used.
